verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships extensive built-in agentic delegation: Work/Codex modes carry tasks through to reviewable results, scheduled/background tasks and event-triggered automations, computer use and browser control, subagent delegation, and voice-initiated task delegation — all first-party features, not third-party add-ons. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of these newer agentic features (Work, subagents, Computer Use) beyond vendor docs.
